answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Powder Pop on Nibbit, spent its Spark on Ka-pow! targeting Nibbit, then played Jumpy Dumpty and Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Duck and Cover with Kaboom! for 7 more damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up Kaboom!'s 7 damage in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 12-damage attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have played Kaboom! instead of Duck and Cover.
